title: Answer: only a small subset of self states describe conscious observers

statements.text: Among all self states only a small subset describe agents, and a very small subset of those describe conscious agents. A probabilistic changeling is no less conscious than the agent it replaces, and most kinds of observer state need not be conscious in any meaningful sense.

sources.quote: a very small subset (highlighted in yellow) will have an interpretation as describing conscious self states
If you thought that Charlie1st is conscious, then you have no reason to doubt that Changeling1st is
